capabilities: Render a folder of notes as an editable Gantt timeline with drag-to-reschedule bars and milestones
Show the same tasks as a Kanban board with one column per status and drag-to-change-status
Create FS/SS/FF dependencies and push late predecessors' successors to the next workday
Filter, group, sort tasks and save multiple Gantt, Table, and Kanban views per board
Sync tasks two-way with Google Calendar and send due-date reminders to Discord or Slack webhooks
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Google Calendar sync is desktop-only and requires the user's own Google Cloud project with an unverified-app OAuth warning during consent; notifications fire only while Obsidian is running and date-only tasks are never notified.
problem: Obsidian has no visual project-management view that shows a folder of notes as scheduled tasks on a timeline or a status board.

relations.evidence: shown as tabs above the toolbar, like Wrike's views

requires.name: Google Cloud OAuth client ID and secret

summary: Gantt and Kanban project board that treats each Markdown note in a folder as a task, with drag-to-reschedule bars, dependencies, and saved views.
